research.audience: Young Indian adults (18-30) planning birthdays for partners or close friends
research.problem: Struggling to buy a generic frame that doesn't capture the look or personality of the person you love
research.buyer_moment: Standing in a crowded local market looking for a unique birthday surprise for your girlfriend, when you see this sketch on Meesho
research.surprise_detail: The frame is actually a photo of a black-and-white sketch, not a real drawing, making it a digital art gift
features: Personalized photo sketch service via WhatsApp
Black and white sketch portrait design

style.label: dramatic reveal transition
style.plan: a dramatic reveal transition: a plain, slightly dull scene, then a quick snap-cut that reveals the product in a bright, beautiful hero shot.
style.shots: A plain dull scene with the {p} barely visible; a snap cut with a whoosh; the {p} glows in a bright hero shot.
style.audio_line: Voice: NO voice, no talking. Music: a build-up that drops with a short whoosh at the reveal.
style.yt_line: Vertical 10-second dramatic reveal: a plain dull scene, then a snap-cut transition reveals the product in a bright, beautiful shot. Camera: low-angle hero shot, warm and festive mood.
style.look_extra: Camera: low-angle hero shot, warm and festive mood.
style.ad_brief: AD LEVEL = light: no pitch and no praise. The product is named or shown once, in passing, like a friend mentioning it. PRICE RULE: do NOT mention any price, cost, discount, offer, 'cheap', 'cheapest' or 'budget' anywhere (no rupee amounts, no Rs, no numbers about money).
style.caption_tone: Keep the caption casual: one friendly line plus one short mention of what the product is, no pitch. Do not mention the price.
style.caption_cta: Want it? Comment LINK, the link lands in your DM
hook_ideas: Ye usko bhejo jise ye chahiye
style.setting: sunlit window sill with soft shadows
style.trend: Viral line ideas (optional, adapt to the product, skip if they do not fit): Ye usko bhejo jise ye chahiye / Isko 10 mein se kitne doge? / Wait for it...
style.overlay: Show big, clear on-screen text captions, spelled exactly: Make her smile today, then Comment LINK, then Link in your DM.
